name: Gacha Marbles League
subtitle: DEMO
contributions: Designed a GOAP system for enemy turns that scores shot candidates using heuristics and selects actions via weighted stochastic choice with personality profiles.
Built a data-driven Power system with ScriptableObjects: polymorphic conditions and actions (SerializeReference) executed as sequenced coroutines with stamina cost and combat event resolution.
Implemented a save/load persistence manager supporting multiple player profiles, auto-save intervals, optional encryption, and an IDataPersistence interface for scene-wide state synchronization.
Architected an asynchronous Command pattern for battle events with priority-based execution, coroutine sequencing, and decoupled feedback playback via MoreMountains MMFeedbacks.
Developed a battle architecture using Service Locator dependency injection and a phase-based state machine to orchestrate combat systems.
